opening.argument: The recorded material is a short Bitcoin presentation focused on cryptocurrency markets and market capitalization. The speaker says, “I'm not giving presentation to the company, just a short presentation for those that aren't familiar with the bitcoin,” and notes that Bitcoin’s capitalization exceeds six billion. A CoinMarketCap-style display likewise shows cryptocurrency market-capitalization data, prices, volumes, changes and graphs. The title mentions OneCoin, and the description supplies a signup link and Skype contact, which suggest promotion. But the speech does not make a concrete return promise or explain any required payment or data request. Those circumstances do not establish a deceptive solicitation.
